description: Explicit provisional engineering fixture. Not calibrated, not reference defaults.

rho_air_kg_m3.source: Constant dry-air approximation; not the reference moist-air operating density.

cp_air_J_kgK.source: Constant dry-air engineering approximation, not an extracted medium property.

h_interior_W_m2K.source: Constant interior convection engineering fixture; source uses nonlinear exchange.

h_exterior_W_m2K.source: Constant opaque exterior convection fixture, not weather-dependent reference exchange.

h_radiation_W_m2K.source: Linear reciprocal opaque-surface radiation fixture; not reference view factors.

approximations: Dry air with fixed rho and cp; no moisture, latent heat or CO2.
Interior/exterior constant convection; exterior longwave omitted.
Symmetric all-to-all linear opaque-surface radiation; glazing excluded from radiation network.
Static window UA uses source rating U times source area; no glazing storage/optics.
Absorbed solar is an explicit per-surface power input, not calculated from irradiance.
Convective and radiative heating/internal gains are separate explicit power inputs.
Radiative gains distributed by opaque interior area, not exact reference view factors.
